pkgmetadata.longdescription: prowl-agent is a local, CLI-first code index for AI agents: it parses a tree with Tree-sitter into an SQLite (FTS5 + vector) store and answers queries with small, cited excerpts instead of whole files, over the command line or as an MCP server. Ryoku Rashin uses it to build the vault's code map ("ryoku-rashin index") and to install its agent skills ("ryoku-rashin wire"); this package follows the commit Ryoku pins.
